Hey team —

We have Cody Nguyen scheduled for a 60-minute ML coding screen on Thu Aug 5 at 11:00 AM PDT (candidate is in SF). Prof. Ana Morales (external, guest interviewer) will join as the third interviewer — she is coming from her university and won't have a Redwood account. Two asks:

1) Can we provision a guest interviewer login for Prof. Morales that allows CoderPad access (read/write) and session recording? We need a short step-by-step so the guest can sign-in without SSO.

2) Please confirm the environment we'll use: candidate prefers Colab (GPU not required) but Ben mentioned we sometimes prefer CoderPad for timeboxed prompts. Can we give both links and a fallback policy? Also want to confirm recording consent workflow — we must get signed consent from both candidate and guest.

Attached: candidate resume (Cody_Nguyen_Resume.pdf).

Laura

Subject: Re: Setup: Cody Nguyen — ML coding session (guest interviewer access + recording consent)

Thanks Laura — quick answers below. I'm copying Ops (Kim) for the guest account provisioning.

Environment + links:
- Primary: CoderPad (timeboxed 45m prompt + 15m debrief). Use this session link for the interview: https://coderpad.io/session/REDWOOD-4521 — it's pre-seeded with our runner and python3 environment.
- Fallback: Colab (candidate asked for it). Shared Colab: https://colab.research.google.com/drive/1a2b3c-example — start there if the candidate requests notebook-style work. Note: Colab doesn't support enforced timeboxing, so moderator should keep an eye on time.

Guest access + recording:
- I've created a one-time guest role flow. Kim, please send Prof. Morales the guest_access_instructions.pdf which includes a temporary token and steps to join CoderPad without SSO. Token expires 72 hours after creation.
- Recording: we capture the CoderPad session (screen + audio) and store in our internal Drive folder. We need explicit consent from both the candidate and Prof. Morales before starting. The consent form link is at the runbook folder (see Drive link).

Attachments (sent to Kim): guest_access_instructions.pdf (includes token and minimal readme).

I'll set the CoderPad session to allow microphone + clipboard sharing. Marcus — can you be moderator and start the recording at the top of the session? Monica — please take the debrief notes and upload to the hiring folder after the call.

Ben
Ben Carter
Interview Ops | Redwood Inference

Hi Prof. Morales —

Forwarding the plan for Thursday. I've attached the guest instructions (guest_access_instructions.pdf) — the file includes:
- A one-time token and short URL to establish your guest session on CoderPad
- Browser compatibility notes (Chrome recommended), microphone + camera permissions, and troubleshooting tips
- How to join the recording and a short checklist for audio/video consent

Please confirm: are you OK giving consent to record the session (audio + screen) and having the recording stored in Redwood's hiring folder for 90 days (used only for calibration and debrief)? If yes, reply-all with a short line: "I consent to recording for the purposes described."

Quick note on timezones: the session is set for Thu Aug 5, 11:00 AM PDT — if you prefer we can flip to 2:00 PM EDT to match east-coast availability; let us know.

Best,
